defaultPrompt: Verify whether jane.doe@example.com is a real, deliverable email address.
Check this list of email addresses and tell me which ones are invalid or disposable.
Is this email address safe to send to?
interface.longDescription: Email Verify checks whether an email address is real and safe to send to, using syntax validation, disposable-domain detection, MX records and live SMTP verification. Ask about a single address or paste a list and get a plain verdict for each one: valid, invalid, risky or unknown, with the reason. Built for developers, marketers and founders who want clean mailing lists without leaving their AI assistant. Connect with OAuth. An Email Verify account is required.

publication.release_notes: Initial release. Verify a single email address or a list of addresses in chat, with syntax, disposable-domain, MX and live SMTP checks and a plain verdict for each address. Sign-in uses OAuth against your existing Email Verify account.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT. Verifications draw on the credits of the user's existing Email Verify account.
